generic.Defined scope/population: All in-scope risks for the treaty requiring quota-share and surplus cession rules applied by line and territory.
generic.In-scope period: The underwriting period bounded by the treaty inception and expiry dates being ceded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention amount, surplus line count, territory, line of business and treaty section present on every risk.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of risks with cession rules applied agrees to the cedable policy population count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cession rule application log saved with run timestamp and treaty rule version in the reinsurance system.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks breaching treaty per-risk or per-event capacity are logged with the referral decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All risks processed by the cession rule run for the treaty period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero risks ceded above the treaty per-risk or per-event capacity limit.
generic.Exception handling path: Capacity breaches and routing errors return to the Ceded Reinsurance Analyst queue for reallocation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cession rule log shows retention, quota-share and surplus split per risk in treaty order.
generic.Evidence location: Cession rule application log in the reinsurance administration system treaty run folder.

steps.title: Load treaty retention and surplus configuration in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the treaty record for the class of business in the reinsurance administration system
Read the retention amount and the number of surplus lines configured
Compare the configuration to the signed treaty slip held on the treaty file
Done when retention and surplus line settings are confirmed against the signed slip
verify: Re-read the configured retention and surplus line count against the slip
Pass when both values match the signed slip exactly

steps.title: Extract the cedable risk population from the policy administration system
sop: Run the written-risk extract in the policy administration system for the treaty period
Filter to the treaty class of business, territory and peril codes
Load the extract into the reinsurance administration system cession run
Done when the risk population is staged for the cession run
verify: Compare the staged record count to the policy extract row count
Pass when the two counts are equal

steps.title: Apply the quota-share cession percentage in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the quota-share cession step before any surplus allocation
Apply the treaty quota-share percentage to each risk in the population
Record the ceded and retained amounts per risk on the run output
Done when every risk carries a quota-share ceded and retained split
verify: Recompute the quota-share split on five risks by hand
Pass when the manual split agrees to the system split on all five

steps.title: Cede the balance above retention to surplus lines in treaty order
sop: Take the balance above retention for each risk after the quota-share step
Allocate the balance across surplus lines in the order set on the treaty
Stop allocation once the available surplus lines are exhausted
Done when every above-retention balance is allocated or flagged unplaced
verify: Check the surplus allocation order against the treaty section sequence
Pass when allocation follows treaty order with no line skipped

steps.title: Check territory and line-of-business routing to treaty sections in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: List the treaty section assigned to each risk in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
Compare the section against the risk territory and line-of-business codes
Reroute any risk assigned to the wrong treaty section
Done when every risk sits on the treaty section its territory and line dictate
verify: Sample twenty risks across territories and check section assignment
Pass when all twenty sit on the correct treaty section

steps.title: Test the cession against treaty per-risk and per-event capacity limits
sop: Run the capacity check over the completed cession in the reinsurance administration system
List any risk ceded above the per-risk or per-event capacity limit
Refer each breach back for reallocation or facultative placement
Done when no risk remains ceded above treaty capacity
verify: Re-run the capacity check after reallocation
Pass when the breach list returns nil

steps.title: Spot-check retention-boundary risks and retain the cession run log
sop: Select five risks with sums insured straddling the retention boundary
Recompute the retained and ceded split for each in the reinsurance system
Save the cession rule application log with run timestamp and rule version
Done when the five checks agree and the run log is retained
verify: Open the retained log and confirm retention, quota-share and surplus split per risk
Pass when the log shows all three elements for every risk in the run

generic.Defined scope/population: The cession booking batch prepared for the period and presented for release to the general ledger.
generic.In-scope period: The accounting period whose cession booking batch is being approved before GL release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty code, underwriting year, booking value, preparer identity and reconciling item list on the pack.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Batch total on the approval pack agrees to the period cession summary total.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No batch released to the GL without a recorded approver within the delegated limit.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval record on the batch shows approver identity and timestamp before GL release.
generic.Evidence location: Approval queue audit trail in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Assemble the cession booking pack in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Pull the cession booking batch and the period cession summary for the treaty
Attach the reconciling item list and its clearance status to the pack
Route the pack into the reinsurance system approval queue
Done when the pack is in the approval queue with all attachments
verify: Open the queued pack and check the summary and reconciling list are attached
Pass when both attachments are present on the queued item

steps.title: Review the booking pack against treaty terms in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the treaty terms screen alongside the booking pack
Check cession percentages, commission rates and sections used against the treaty
Query any line that does not follow the treaty terms before proceeding
Done when every booking line is traced to a treaty term
verify: Re-check three booking lines against the treaty terms screen
Pass when all three agree to the recorded treaty terms

steps.title: Confirm the booking value sits within the delegated authority limit
sop: Read the total booking value from the pack in Microsoft Excel
Compare it to the approver delegated authority limit for the treaty
Escalate to the higher authority where the value exceeds the limit
Done when the approval authority for the value is established
verify: Compare recorded booking value to the authority matrix limit
Pass when the value sits at or below the approver limit or an escalation is recorded

steps.title: Clear or accept flagged reconciling items with the preparer
sop: Work through each reconciling item flagged during preparation
Clear items that can be corrected before release
Record an explicit acceptance and reason for any item left open
Done when every flagged item is cleared or accepted in writing
verify: Count open items against the number carrying an acceptance note
Pass when no open item lacks a recorded acceptance

steps.title: Record the approval in the reinsurance system approval queue
sop: Approve the batch inside the reinsurance system approval queue, not by email
Add an approval note referencing the treaty and period reviewed
Confirm the batch status changes to Approved
Done when the approval is captured against the batch with identity and time
verify: Open the batch audit trail and read the approver identity and timestamp
Pass when both are present on the batch record

steps.title: Release the approved batch to the general ledger
sop: Confirm the batch status shows Approved before any release action
Release the batch to the ERP general ledger interface
Check the GL batch total against the reinsurance subledger batch total
Done when the batch is posted to the GL and totals agree
verify: Compare the posted GL batch total to the approved pack total
Pass when the two totals are equal and an approver is recorded on the batch

generic.Defined scope/population: All proportional treaty policies in scope for the underwriting period requiring ceded premium calculation.

generic.Evidence location: Ceded premium calculation output in the reinsurance administration system and Excel working.

steps.title: Confirm the cession terms on the treaty record against the signed slip
sop: Open the treaty record in the reinsurance administration system
Read the quota-share cession percentage and surplus line count
Compare both against the signed slip held on the treaty file
Done when the recorded terms are confirmed to match the slip
verify: Re-read the cession percentage on the treaty record against the slip
Pass when the percentage and line count match the slip

steps.title: Extract gross written premium net of returns and cancellations

Net off return premiums and cancellations recorded in the same period
Load the netted premium base into the cession calculation run
Done when the netted premium base is staged for calculation
verify: Compare the netted base to the gross premium register less returns

steps.title: Apply the cession percentage to the netted premium base
sop: Run the ceded premium calculation in the reinsurance administration system
Apply the confirmed cession percentage to the netted premium per policy
Review the output for policies returning nil or negative ceded premium
Done when a ceded premium value exists for every in-scope policy
verify: List policies where ceded premium exceeds gross written premium
Pass when that list is empty

steps.title: Split ceded premium by underwriting year and treaty section
sop: Allocate each ceded premium row to its underwriting year
Assign the treaty section where the treaty runs multiple sections
Produce the calculation output grouped by section and underwriting year
Done when every row carries a section and underwriting year
verify: Check the grouped output totals sum back to the overall ceded premium
Pass when the grouped total equals the ungrouped total

steps.title: Recompute a ten-policy sample in Microsoft Excel
sop: Export ten policies spanning sections and underwriting years to Excel
Recompute ceded premium from gross premium and cession percentage
Compare each recomputed figure to the system-calculated figure
Done when all ten agree to the cent or the difference is explained
verify: Read the variance column across the ten sample rows
Pass when every variance is zero

steps.title: Check endorsement and cancellation flow through in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: List mid-term endorsements and cancellations for the period
Confirm each carries the same cession basis as the original risk
Correct any endorsement ceded on a different basis
Done when all endorsements and cancellations use the original cession basis
verify: Sample five endorsements and compare cession basis to the parent policy
Pass when all five match the parent basis

generic.Defined scope/population: All non-proportional XoL layers on the treaty programme requiring premium calculation for the year.

steps.title: Confirm the subject premium income definition per layer against the treaty wording
sop: Read the subject premium income clause in the treaty wording
Record which lines of business and territories fall into the SPI base
Note any exclusions from the SPI base per layer
Done when the SPI definition is recorded for every layer
verify: Compare the recorded SPI definition to the treaty wording clause
Pass when the definition matches the wording with no line unaccounted for

steps.title: Extract actual subject premium from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the data warehouse for premium matching the SPI definition
Apply the treaty year boundaries to the extract
Record the extract date and row count on the calculation control sheet
Done when the actual SPI figure is extracted and controlled
verify: Reconcile the extracted SPI total to the gross premium register for the same scope
Pass when the two totals agree within the stated tolerance

steps.title: Record the deposit premium instalment schedule and payments made
sop: Read the deposit premium instalment schedule for each layer from the treaty
List instalments already paid against each layer in the reinsurance system
Show the remaining instalments due for the treaty year
Done when paid and outstanding instalments are listed per layer
verify: Compare instalments listed as paid to the cash ledger entries
Pass when every paid instalment has a matching cash entry

steps.title: Apply the rate-on-line per layer to adjusted subject premium in Microsoft Excel
sop: Multiply the adjusted subject premium by the layer rate-on-line
Compute the minimum and deposit premium adjustment where actual differs from estimate
Compare the result to the layer minimum and deposit premium
Done when each layer carries a calculated premium and adjustment
verify: Check each layer premium against its minimum and deposit premium band
Pass when no layer premium falls below the treaty minimum premium

steps.title: Record attachment, limit and reinstatement detail alongside each layer premium
sop: Add the attachment point and limit to each layer premium line
Record the number of reinstatements available on the layer
Store the completed calculation in the reinsurance administration system
Done when every layer line carries attachment, limit and reinstatement count
verify: Check the layer detail against the treaty schedule of layers
Pass when attachment, limit and reinstatements match the treaty schedule

steps.title: Review the layer premium calculation with the treaty specialist
sop: Walk through the SPI base, rate-on-line and adjustment for each layer
Challenge any layer where the adjustment moves premium materially
Record the review outcome on the calculation cover sheet
Done when every layer calculation is reviewed and signed
verify: Read the cover sheet for reviewer name and date per layer
Pass when all layers carry a recorded review

steps.title: Pull ceding commission and brokerage rates per layer from the treaty terms screen
sop: Open the treaty terms screen in the reinsurance administration system
Read the ceding commission rate and brokerage rate for each treaty layer
Record both rates against the layer on the calculation sheet
Done when every layer carries a sourced commission and brokerage rate
verify: Trace each recorded rate back to the treaty terms screen
Pass when no rate is used that is absent from the treaty record

steps.title: Establish ceded premium net of return premium per treaty section
sop: Extract ceded premium by treaty section for the period
Deduct return premium recorded in the same period
Stage the netted ceded premium as the commission base
Done when a netted commission base exists per treaty section
verify: Compare the netted base to the ceded premium subledger less returns
Pass when the base agrees to the subledger calculation

steps.title: Apply the commission rate to the netted base in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Run the commission calculation over each treaty section
Apply the layer commission rate to the netted ceded premium
Review the output for sections returning nil commission
Done when commission is calculated for every entitled section
verify: Recompute commission for two sections in Microsoft Excel
Pass when both recomputed figures equal the system figures

steps.title: Calculate broker brokerage separately from ceding commission
sop: Apply the brokerage rate to the same netted ceded premium base
Present brokerage on its own line rather than netted into commission
Show gross and net-of-brokerage balances on the calculation output
Done when brokerage is presented as a discrete calculated amount
verify: Check the output has separate commission and brokerage columns
Pass when both amounts are shown discretely with their rates

steps.title: Exclude the provisional profit commission element from this calculation
sop: Identify any overrider or profit commission provisional element in the output
Remove it from the provisional ceding commission figure
Note where the profit commission element will instead be recorded
Done when the provisional figure carries no profit commission element
verify: Search the calculation for profit commission or overrider lines
Pass when none is included in the provisional commission total

steps.title: Agree total commission and brokerage to the treaty account before release
sop: Compare total commission and brokerage to the treaty account commission line
Investigate any difference by treaty layer before release
Store the agreed calculation against the treaty period record
Done when the calculation is agreed to the treaty account and stored
verify: Read the difference between calculation total and treaty account line
Pass when the difference is nil or fully explained in writing

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaties and treaty sections with cession activity in the closed period being summarised.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, section, underwriting year, ceded premium, commission, brokerage and net balance columns.

steps.title: Generate the cession summary by treaty and section in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the cession summary report for the closed period
Group the output by treaty, treaty section and underwriting year
Confirm the report cut-off date matches the period close date
Done when the grouped summary is generated for the closed period
verify: Check the report header cut-off against the close calendar date
Pass when the cut-off date matches the closed period

steps.title: Present premium, commission, brokerage and net balance as separate columns

Avoid netting commission or brokerage into the ceded premium column
Format the summary in Microsoft Excel for review
Done when all four values appear as discrete columns
verify: Check the column set on the formatted summary
Pass when premium, commission, brokerage and net balance are each present

steps.title: Add prior-period comparatives and a variance column
sop: Pull the prior-period cession summary for the same treaties
Add comparative and variance columns to the current summary
Apply the materiality threshold to identify variances needing explanation
Done when every treaty row carries a comparative and variance
verify: Count treaty rows without a prior-period comparative
Pass when that count is zero

sop: List variances exceeding the materiality threshold

Write the explanation against the variance row

verify: Check material variance rows for an explanation entry

steps.title: Tie the summary total back to the ceded premium subledger

Compare it to the summary total ceded premium
Investigate and document any difference by treaty
Done when the summary ties to the subledger or the difference is documented

Pass when the difference is nil or documented

steps.title: Publish and circulate the summary to finance and reinsurance operations
sop: Publish the summary view in Power BI for finance and operations
Circulate the summary stating the period cut-off date
Record the circulation date and recipient list
Done when the summary is circulated with the cut-off date stated
verify: Open the circulated summary and check the header states the cut-off
Pass when the cut-off date and comparative columns are visible on the issued version

steps.title: Run the written and in-force extract in the policy administration system
sop: Run the written and in-force extract for the underwriting period
Bound the extract by the treaty inception and expiry dates
Record the run parameters and row count on the extract control sheet
Done when the raw policy population is extracted and controlled
verify: Compare extract date bounds to the treaty inception and expiry dates

steps.title: Filter the population by treaty class, territory and peril codes

steps.title: Exclude facultative-placed and treaty-excluded policies
sop: Identify policies flagged as facultative-placed in the policy system
Identify policies caught by the treaty exclusions clause
Remove both groups and log each with its exclusion reason
Done when excluded policies are removed and logged
verify: Scan the retained cedable list for any treaty-exclusion flag
Pass when no policy in the cedable list carries an exclusion flag

steps.title: Confirm sum insured sits within the treaty attachment or retention band
sop: Compare each policy sum insured or EML to the treaty attachment point
Confirm surplus candidates sit above the retention band
Flag policies below the attachment for removal from the population

steps.title: Reconcile the cedable count and premium to the gross written premium register

Compare cedable policy count and gross written premium to the register
Document the difference between register and cedable population
Done when the difference is quantified and explained
verify: Read the reconciliation difference between cedable population and register
Pass when the difference is fully attributable to exclusions and out-of-scope classes

steps.title: Publish the cedable population to the data warehouse for the cession run
sop: Load the final cedable population to the enterprise data warehouse
Attach the record count and gross written premium control total
Version the dataset with the extract date
Done when the population is published with its control totals attached

Pass when record count and premium control total are both present

sop: Post ceding commission to the ceding commission account

Check the account mapping table for each posting line
Done when commission and brokerage sit in their designated accounts
verify: Read the ceded premium account for any commission or brokerage amounts
Pass when neither is netted into the ceded premium account

steps.title: Confirm reinsurer counterparty codes match the treaty participant shares
sop: List the treaty participants and signed shares in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
Compare the counterparty code on each entry to the participant list
Correct any entry pointing at the wrong reinsurer counterparty
Done when every entry carries the correct counterparty code and share

sop: Read the batch control total from the reinsurance subledger
